newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-ROSTSELMASH ROSTOV TAKES OVER AT TOP IN RUSSIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROSTSELMASH ROSTOV TAKES OVER AT TOP IN RUSSIA.

text.p: Unfashionable Rostselmash Rostov scored a shock 2-0 win over Rotor Volgograd on Wednesday to take over from them at the top of the Russian premier league.
Russian international Alexei Gerasimenko opened the scoring in the 60th minute and Ukrainian import Vladislav Prodius sealed victory 17 minutes later.

Rostselmash overtook both Rotor and defending champions Spartak Moscow, who were held to a scoreless draw by city rivals CSKA. Rostselmash have 16 points after seven matches, two points more than Rotor and Spartak.

Alania Vladikavkaz, last year's runners-up, continued their poor start to the season by losing their third successive league and cup match. They were beaten 2-1 at home by Lokomotiv Moscow and slipped to an unlikely 13th place.
Torpedo Moscow, who had scored 11 goals in their two previous matches, could manage only a single goal against Zenit St Petersburg and went down 2-1 at home.
Another Moscow club, Dynamo, easily beat Lokomotiv Nizhny Novgorod 3-0 at home to move into fourth place on 13 points.
